sponsored.t: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Dix to be a nonresident of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Dix, county of Schuyler, to be a nonresident of such town.

sponsored.t: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Monroe county
sponsored.sum: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Monroe county.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Lt. Thomas Cleere to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Lt. Thomas Cleere to change his service credit from the improved career retirement plan to a 20 year retirement plan.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an optional 20-year retirement benefits plan for Elmira traffic officers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an optional 20-year retirement plan for traffic officers employed by the town of Elmira, who submit an application therefor within one year of the effective date of such provisions, or within one year of start of employment.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the renewal of the WSKG lease for such land, tower and associated utility lines
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the renewal of the WSKG lease for such land, tower and associated utility lines to the Tioga county emergency services, the Newark Valley central school district, the Berkshire fire department and the town of Berkshire highway department for a period of ten years.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "ratepayer disclosure and transparency act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "ratepayer disclosure and transparency act" which requires a monthly report that includes the estimated or actual ratepayer costs and benefits of any mandated state energy program to the governor and legislature including any New York climate leadership and community protection act compliance costs.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanded approval power for actions taken at meetings of the New York state energy research and development authority
sponsored.sum: Expands approval power for actions taken at meetings of the New York state energy research and development authority to include the temporary president of the senate, the speaker of the assembly, the minority leader of the senate, and the minority leader of the assembly.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Sgt. Bethany Kidd to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Sgt. Bethany Kidd to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan for service with the Seneca Falls Police Department.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of funds in the New York state climate investment account
sponsored.sum: Allows surplus or uncommitted funds in the New York state climate investment account to be returned to ratepayers.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier II membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Cory M. Rose
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier II membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Cory M. Rose for part-time employment during 2004--2005.

sponsored.t: Grants peace officer status to officers and members of the security force of Arnot Health, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Grants peace officer status to officers and members of the security force of Arnot Health, Inc.

sponsored.t: Establishes a home heating tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a home heating tax credit for qualified taxpayers with an income of $125,000 or less for single filers, or with a combined income of $250,000 or less for joint filers.

sponsored.t: Grants free access and parking at state parks for active-duty military members and veterans
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Grants free access and parking at state parks for active-duty military members and veterans upon showing an active-duty military or veteran's ID card.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for the crimes relating to methamphetamine laboratory operations
sponsored.sum: Relates to penalties for the crimes relating to methamphetamine laboratory operations, including criminal possession of methamphetamine manufacturing materials and unlawful manufacture of methamphetamines.

sponsored.t: Relates to including the mourning dove within the definition of "migratory game birds" and to allow for their taking
sponsored.sum: Allows for the taking of Zenaida macroura, commonly known as the mourning dove, as a migratory bird.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a correction to an error in the tax assessment rolls of the Bath Central School District; and making an appropriation therefor
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a correction to an error in the tax assessment rolls of the Bath Central School District; makes an appropriation of $500,000 to address the school district's shortfall that resulted from the error.

sponsored.t: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase Medicaid fraud detection software
sponsored.sum: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase Medicaid fraud detection software.
sponsored.fis: Undetermined at this time. However, any cost would conceivably be accom- plished through FWA investigation, prosecution and deterrence.

sponsored.t: Requires the division of state police to send renewal notices to holders of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver before expiration of such license
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of state police to send renewal notices to holders of a license to carry or possess a pistol or revolver at least 90 days before expiration of such license.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "omnibus emergency services volunteer incentive act" to provide certain benefits to volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "omnibus emergency services volunteer incentive act" to provide benefits to volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers; increases the personal income tax deduction after four or more years of service; exempts motor vehicles used in the performance of such volunteers' duties from registration fees, use taxes and special fees for volunteer license plates; authorizes the provision of municipal health insurance coverage to such volunteers; establishes a volunteer recruitment service loan forgiveness program.

sponsored.t: Relates to business income base and certain small business taxpayers
sponsored.sum: Relates to business income base and certain small business taxpayers.

sponsored.t: Includes certain acts and subsequent penalties in the criminal sale of cannabis
sponsored.sum: Includes certain acts and subsequent penalties in the criminal sale of cannabis.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of the department of health to apply for a waiver to implement a work requirement for able-bodied adult recipients of Medicaid
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the department of health to apply for a waiver to implement a work requirement for able-bodied adult recipients of Medicaid.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an increase in the maximum speed limit for travel on certain roadways
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an increase in the maximum speed limit to 70 mph for travel on roadways that currently have a maximum speed limit of 65 mph.

sponsored.t: Includes the throwing, tossing or expelling of saliva at or on an employee of a correctional facility within the crime of aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual
sponsored.sum: Includes the throwing, tossing or expelling of saliva at or on an employee of a correctional facility within the crime of aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "responsible renewable energy recycling act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "responsible renewable energy recycling act" to require manufacturers of solar panels, wind turbines, and batteries to collect such materials when they are taken out of use; requires educational outreach relating thereto; establishes collection goals therefor; requires reporting of collection efforts.

sponsored.t: Relates to a state agency adopting emergency regulations
sponsored.sum: Requires a state agency to get approval from the senate and the assembly prior to adopting or readopting a rule on an emergency basis unless such rule is necessary on an emergency basis for the preservation of the public health, safety and general welfare of the public.

sponsored.t: Removes restrictions on crossbow size and draw weight when used for hunting
sponsored.sum: Removes restrictions on crossbow size and draw weight when used for hunting.

sponsored.t: Enacts the interstate medical licensure compact
sponsored.sum: Enacts the interstate medical licensure compact; provides a streamlined process that allows physicians to become licensed in multiple participating states, thereby enhancing the portability of a medical license and ensuring the safety of patients.

sponsored.t: Relates to the transportation of liquefied natural and petroleum gas; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the transportation of liquefied natural and petroleum gas.

sponsored.t: Includes reckless operation of a motor vehicle resulting in the death or serious injury of a companion animal in the definition aggravated animal cruelty
sponsored.sum: Includes reckless operation of a motor vehicle resulting in the death or serious injury of a companion animal in the definition of aggravated animal cruelty.

sponsored.t: Makes technical corrections to the environmental conservation law, providing for misdemeanor penalties for hunting, trapping, or fishing without a valid license
sponsored.sum: Makes technical corrections to the environmental conservation law, providing for misdemeanor penalties for hunting, trapping, or fishing without a valid license.

sponsored.t: Relates to hunting, fishing and outdoor education in high school physical education courses
sponsored.sum: Permits instruction in hunting, fishing and outdoor education in high school physical education courses.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the village of Bath, in Steuben county; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Bath, in Steuben county to adopt and amend local laws imposing a tax on persons occupying a room for hire in any hotel in an amount not to exceed 2% of the per diem rental rate for each room; provides for the expiration and repeal of such provisions on September 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to the possession and sale of methamphetamine
sponsored.sum: Makes penalties for the possession and/or sale of methamphetamine similar to that of the penalties for possession and/or sale of heroin and cocaine.

sponsored.t: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase document management software designed specifically for the child welfare industry
sponsored.sum: Reimburses counties who have purchased or will purchase document management software designed specifically for the child welfare industry.
sponsored.fis: Undetermined at this time. However, making the system more streamlined and efficient will significantly increase worker productivity and lower the active caseload burden on county's departments of social services.

sponsored.t: Allows retired state police officers to serve as police officers for local police departments without diminution of retirement benefits
sponsored.sum: Allows retired state police officers to serve as police officers for local police departments without diminution of retirement benefits; empowers the superintendent of state police to approve such service.

sponsored.t: Includes fires caused by the manufacture of a controlled substance within the crime of arson in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Includes fires caused by the manufacture of a controlled substance within the crime of arson in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to stolen firearms, shotguns and rifles; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to criminal penalties for possession, theft, or sale of stolen firearms, shotguns and rifles; makes technical corrections to section 155.42 of the penal law.

sponsored.t: Authorizes any justice or judge in the state to obtain a license to have and carry concealed a pistol or revolver
sponsored.sum: Authorizes any justice or judge in the state to obtain a license to have and carry concealed a pistol or revolver; such amendments allow such justices and judges to carry concealed in the courthouse, when read in conjunction with existing language in paragraph (g) of subdivision 3 of section 265.01-e of the penal law.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Mark Barnhart, David Skinner, and James Pappas to take the competitive civil service examination and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment with the village of Wayland
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Mark Barnhart, David Skinner, and James Pappas to take the competitive civil service examination and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment as full-time police officers with the village of Wayland.

sponsored.t: Requires the county seat in Seneca county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
sponsored.sum: Requires the county seat in Seneca county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.
sponsored.fis: No fiscal implication to the State.

sponsored.t: Establishes programs to encourage the removal and replacement of single-wall steel home heating oil storage tanks which are leaking or otherwise pose a threat to the environment
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of environmental conservation and office of temporary and disability assistance to establish programs to encourage the removal and replacement of single-wall steel home heating oil storage tanks which are leaking or otherwise pose a threat to the environment.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting homeowners from tax increases for certain renewable energy systems
sponsored.sum: Relates to exempting homeowners from tax increases for certain renewable energy systems.

sponsored.t: Grants peace officer status to animal control officers of the county of Schuyler
sponsored.sum: Grants peace officer status to animal control officers of the county of Schuyler; defines "animal control officer".

sponsored.t: Permits animal-drawn vehicles to equip and use amber flashing lights
sponsored.sum: Permits animal-drawn vehicles to equip and use amber flashing lights; does not apply to such vehicles in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Makes the crimes of menacing and stalking bail eligible
sponsored.sum: Makes the crimes of menacing and stalking bail eligible.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "stop continuing unnecessary orders and mandates at once act"
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the legislature to modify an executive order.

sponsored.t: Allows school resource officers to be hired with salary aidable to the school district; raises retirement salaries for such officers
sponsored.sum: Allows school resource officers to be hired with salary aidable to the school district; raises retirement salaries for such officers to fifty thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to the availability and purchase of zero-emission school buses
sponsored.sum: Relates to the availability and purchase of zero-emission school buses.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state familial search policy and the release of information for familial DNA searches
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state familial search policy; relates to the release of certain information for familial DNA searches where a written agreement governing the use and dissemination of such DNA records exists.

sponsored.t: Establishes the commission on reopening the Indian Point energy center; relates to definitions relating to renewable energy; repeals provision of public service law; directs a feasibility study on nuclear SMRs
sponsored.sum: Establishes the commission on reopening the Indian Point energy center; relates to definitions of certain terms relating to renewable energy; repeals provisions relating to electric generating facilities; directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study on nuclear small modular reactors.

sponsored.t: Designates uniformed marine patrol officers as peace officers in the county of Seneca
sponsored.sum: Designates uniformed marine patrol officers appointed by the sheriff of Seneca county as peace officers in the county of Seneca.

sponsored.t: Grants free access to state parks for firefighters
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Grants free access to state parks for firefighters upon showing a sufficient method of identification, as designated by the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation or other state agency having jurisdiction.

sponsored.t: Relates to an exemption for certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church
sponsored.sum: Relates to an exemption from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church, for a certain property located in the village of Hammondsport, county of Steuben.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "nuclear energy deployment act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "nuclear energy deployment act"; directs the New York state energy research and development authority, in consultation with the public service commission and the department of environmental conservation, to promulgate rules and regulations to facilitate the construction and operation of advanced nuclear reactors and to review and evaluate certain existing regulations and regulatory actions taken concerning nuclear energy; directs the New York state energy research and development authority to create the position of nuclear energy coordinator; directs the New York state energy research and development authority to administer grants from the nuclear energy deployment fund…

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale or lease of any property in the state to the People's Republic of China or the Chinese communist party
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale or lease of any property in the state to the People's Republic of China or the Chinese communist party.

sponsored.t: Relates to the length of time orders issued to set the rate of gas and electricity are in effect
sponsored.sum: Provides that beginning January 1, 2027, any order issued to set the rate of gas and electricity, not including surcharges or tariffs, shall be in effect for three years.

sponsored.t: Designates certain portions of the state highway system as the "Between Cayuga and Seneca Lakes Wine Trail"
sponsored.sum: Designates certain portions of the state highway system between Cayuga lake and Seneca lake as the "Between Cayuga and Seneca Lakes Wine Trail".

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Montour to be a nonresident of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Montour, county of Schuyler, to be a nonresident of such town.

sponsored.t: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Chemung county
sponsored.sum: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Chemung county.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Sergeant James S. Hayes
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting a portion of state route 14 to Sergeant James S. Hayes.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for the county of Seneca to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration of the authorization for the county of Seneca to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax for two years.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Yates to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Yates to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Steuben
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Steuben until December 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Schuyler to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Schuyler to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Yates
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to the mortgage tax in the county of Yates until December 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Tioga to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Tioga to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Chemung to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Chemung to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes to November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Steuben to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Steuben to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes through November 30, 2027.
